title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior is adopted and sustained in a population under social influence, policy mandates, media messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals update adoption probability based on the share of their contacts who currently wear masks and household norms.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_check
interactions.description: Mandates issued by policymakers are enforced at locations; individuals facing enforcement adjust adherence and access.

interactions.name: media_broadcast
interactions.description: Media sources disseminate messages that alter risk perception and attitudes toward mask-wearing.

interactions.name: purchase_masks
interactions.description: Individuals attempt to buy masks subject to retailer inventory, price, and affordability, updating their mask inventory.

interactions.name: contact_in_location
interactions.description: Individuals interact at home, work/school, and public venues; mask-wearing adherence is applied during contacts.

interactions.name: supply_restock
interactions.description: Retailers replenish inventory according to supply rates and adjust prices as needed.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily fraction of the population wearing masks.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate observed over the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption_70
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first reaches 70%.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_duration_above_70
metrics.description: Total days adoption remains at or above 70% after first reaching it.

metrics.name: policy_noncompliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of individuals not adhering to mask mandates when required.

metrics.name: mask_availability_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals with at least one mask in inventory.

metrics.name: adherence_probability_mean
metrics.description: Average probability that adopters wear masks during contacts.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_gini_income
metrics.description: Gini coefficient of adoption across income groups.
